name: Koko wa Rakuensou 2
source:
The Paradise Heights apartment has changed after half of your uncle's company got liquidated. After the money went, so did some of the tenants. Now Keigo Nakadai (protagonist) works for a toy making company but still stays at Paradise Heights.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/paradise-heights-2]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
叔叔的公司有一半遭到清算后，乐园庄公寓也发生了变化。资金消失，一些住户也随之离去。如今，主人公中代圭吾在一家玩具制造公司工作，但仍住在乐园庄。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/paradise-heights-2]MobyGames[/url]]
